profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at UberEats
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and Venezuelan cultural ambassador, fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Eater Growth & Eater Home Product Engineer @UberEats

positions.title: Cultural Student Ambassador
positions.description:
-Selected from a international pool of 200 applicants to contribute 80 hours per year of cultural and educational service in exchange for nearly-full scholarship assistance.
-Organized presentations and led classes concerning Venezuelan culture.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Provided guidance and mentorship to students during office hours and instructional laboratory classes.
-Graded weekly assignments and exams
-Instructional focus: Introductory Python and Intermediate Data Structures.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Full stack feature engineering for a REST entity API built with Java, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Dropwizard, ReactJS and Javascript. 
Fixed client-side bugs, full stack feature engineering for a REST entity API built with Java, Hibernate, Postgres, Liquibase, Mockito, Dropwizard, Docker, ReactJS, Javascript, HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Social Media Manager
positions.description:
-Managed online television campaigns across multiple social media platforms including: Twitter, Facebook and Youtube.
-Provided customer support, enhanced online engagement.

honors.title: Freshmen Enrichment Award
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Oregon · Jan 2014
